title: Control assertion record
description: The output of every control test. A population statement, never a sample. total + failing[] + query_ref + lineage is strictly stronger evidence than a screenshot or a sampled n, because the auditor can re-run the query.

total.description: The denominator, and itself a control metric. Unexpected drift means the asset inventory (a Decision Support control) failed BEFORE this control did. Alert on denominator movement, not only on failures.

failing.description: ALWAYS fully enumerated. This is simultaneously the work queue and the variance record.

first_observed.description: This is what produces Variance Duration. Without it you have a snapshot; with it you have a clock.

passing.description: Null by default. Populate only for small populations or on auditor request. Enumerating 400k passing rows is storage, not evidence.

coverage_basis.description: Carries exclusions explicitly. Exceptions reduce coverage; they do not vanish from the denominator.

confidence_tier.description: 1-4 data ladder. A well-built pipeline produces tier 4 (internal empirical).

fixture.description: True when this record was generated from synthetic fixture data rather than a real collection. Optional and absent on real records. It exists because additionalProperties is false: without a declared field the stamp cannot ride on the record at all, and a synthetic assertion would be byte-indistinguishable from a real one. Every artifact derived from a set containing one of these is marked NOT REAL EVIDENCE, and src/lib/load.mjs refuses a set that mixes the two.
